data.one_liner: Web implementation of Firebase Cloud Messaging for push notifications.
data.what_it_does: Provides the web side of Firebase Messaging, allowing Flutter web apps to receive push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging. It registers service workers and handles token management and message callbacks.
use_when: You need push notifications in a Flutter web app using Firebase
You already use other Firebase services like firebase_core
You want a simple integration without custom native code
avoid_when: You need a non‑Firebase push solution
strengths: Works seamlessly with other FlutterFire packages
Handles service‑worker registration and token retrieval
data.setup_notes: Add firebase_core and firebase_core_web, configure Firebase project, ensure a service worker file is present as described in Firebase docs
